_doc: Read by .claude/hooks/guard-edits.py (Claude Code, before the edit) and by scripts/check-frozen.py and scripts/check-pr-size.py (CI, any agent). Globs are relative to the repository root, except readonly_anywhere, which matches absolute paths; in size_excluded, a glob without a '/' matches the file name in any folder. Lockfiles are already excluded from the size check. Examples: generated {"glob": "openapi/api.json", "how": "run make spec"}; frozen_when_released {"glob": "db/migration/V*.sql", "why": "released migrations are never edited; add a new one"}; readonly_anywhere {"glob": "*/other-repo/src/generated/*", "why": "another repo's generated code"}; size_excluded {"glob": "*/fixtures/*", "why": "sample data, reviewed by its test"}. Generated files never count toward the size either.
